criteria.title: First page loads — Open Dispense History; latest dispenses appear in the left selector
Scroll loads more — Scroll to bottom; older rows append; loading indicator appears then settles
Select older row — Click a row that only appeared after scroll; detail matches that dispense
criteria.blocker: Desktop list item selection in the infinite scroll container proved difficult to automate reliably. The driver successfully scrolled and loaded page 2 (21 orders visible), but clicking individual cards within the desktop .lg:block container encountered selector visibility issues. The elements were present in the DOM but Playwright reported them as not visible when attempting programmatic clicks.

criteria.title: End of list — Scroll until no more pages; further scrolling does not spam requests
Short list — Encounter with few dispenses: no extra page fetches in a loop
criteria.blocker: This criterion requires a patient/encounter with fewer than 14 dispense orders to verify no pagination loop occurs. The test patient used for criteria 1-4 has 20 dispense orders. Creating a new patient with fewer orders or finding an existing fixture with <14 orders would require additional setup beyond the time budget.

seed_attempt.summary: The QA plan suggested checking GET /api/v1/facility/{facilityId}/order/dispense/?patient={patientId} for a patient with count < 14. The fixture patient has 20 orders from our seeding. Creating a second patient scenario within the time budget was not practical. An API query to find or create a minimal-order patient was considered but not executed to preserve time for core functionality testing (criteria 1-2).

criteria.title: Error resilience — Failed next-page fetch does not clear already loaded items
criteria.blocker: This criterion requires simulating network failure during pagination, which typically involves browser DevTools network throttling or intercepting requests with Playwright's page.route(). Implementing and safely demonstrating error resilience within the automated driver requires careful network manipulation. Given time constraints and the need to verify core happy-path functionality first, this error scenario was not exercised.

criteria.title: No regression — Opening Dispense History or selecting items from the first page still works as before
